Presentation of bailiffs and centgrave at Jagstberg.

Date range: 1655, 1727–1735, 1749–1754, 1766–1779.

Includes: presentation of bailiff Franz Rudolf von Rosenberg after the death of his predecessor Johann Adam von Walderdorff (1655); presentation of bailiff Philipp Christoph Specht von Bubenheim (1727); presentation of a centgrave (1735); reports on allocating presentation costs among the district localities (1749–1754, 1766); and proceedings on the presentation of acting bailiff Georg Dominikus Bischof, with enclosures (1772–1779).

Extent: 1 file.
